messages:
ryan (customer): Hey team — noticed our promo credits got consumed before the paid credits and we were invoiced for the last 2 days. Dashboard shows remaining promo: 9,500; invoice shows we were charged for ~15k tokens on 2024-05-01. Account ID: acct_01Fh2X. Promo code: REDWOOD-TRIAL-3MO. Any idea why promo didn't apply first?

maya (support): Sorry to hear that, ryan. Can you paste the invoice id and a sample request_id or timestamp where you expected promo credits to apply? Also which org & project? I can start an internal check.

ryan (customer): invoice_20240501_8421, sample requests: req_9c3a and req_9c3b (both around 2024-05-01T14:12:05Z). Org: org-acme-prod. Project: acme-webhooks.

maya (support): Thanks. I'm pulling usage and credit application logs now. One sec.

billing-bot: [auto] New support ticket created: TKT-3429 (billing credit mismatch). Assigned to @sanjay.

sanjay (billing): Looking. At a glance: invoice shows paid balance used before promo credits, which is opposite of internal policy (promo should be used first / FIFO by credit grant date). Escalating to eng for metering repro. @lucas can you take a look at charge application ordering for acct_01Fh2X?

lucas (engineer): On it. Initial hunch: metering service sorts credit buckets by created_at descending in some cases -> LIFO. Will reproduce with a test harness. Can you provide the exact credit grants and timestamps?

maya (support): Promo grant record attached from our admin UI: grant_id: grant_9876, created_at: 2024-02-01T09:16:00Z, amount_tokens: 250000. Paid credits from card charge id: ch_01G2X, created_at: 2024-04-25T03:20:00Z, amount_tokens: 200000. Ryan says he used API intermittently from 2024-04-25 -> 2024-05-02.

lucas (engineer): Thanks. I reproduced locally by creating two credit buckets with those timestamps and then replaying token consumption. Repro steps: 
1) create credit buckets via /admin/credits:create for acct_01Fh2X (promo older, paid newer)
2) send generation requests via /v1/completions with length ~512 tokens, 10 requests spaced 5s apart
3) query /billing/allocations?account=acct_01Fh2X
Result: allocations show paid-credit buckets consumed first. Code path note: allocation sorter uses sort_key = -created_at when paid_credit.flag == true (bug introduced in 2024-03 refactor).

maya (support): That explains the mismatch between dashboard remaining promo and the invoice. What's the mitigation? Ryan prefers manual correction and invoice adjustment if possible.

sanjay (billing): We'll issue a manual credit transfer to consume promo credits for the affected window and create a refund/credit memo for the invoice_20240501_8421. Proposing: apply 15k tokens worth of promo to the time window in question and issue invoice credit of ~$3.45 (estimate). Need confirmed total charged tokens for that invoice to finalize.

ryan (customer): Appreciate that. Please let me know ETA — the team budgeted around the promo.

lucas (engineer): Short-term fix: patch ready, tests added. Root cause: allocation sorting used reversed timestamp ordering for non-zero-cost buckets. I'll deploy a hotfix to staging now and schedule prod deploy after validation. Patch changes sorter to ascending created_at.

sanjay (billing): Internal note: TKT-3429 -> follow-up action: manual adj + credit memo, created CHG-5671. We will refund invoice_20240501_8421 on 2024-05-03 if finance approves.

billing-bot: [auto] Billing credit memo created: CM-1145 for invoice_20240501_8421 (pending finance approval).

maya (support): Ryan — I'm filing the manual adj now. Once finance approves, you'll see a credit memo applied and the invoice balance updated. ETA 24-72 hours. Also I'll add you to the ticket for updates.

ryan (customer): OK thanks. One more ask: can you add a view in the dashboard that shows credit application order & per-request allocation? That would've made debugging easier on our side.

lucas (engineer): Good feedback. I'll propose a small dashboard change: allocation inspector that shows per-request which credit bucket was used and the resulting remaining amounts. Adding to eng backlog (ENG-alloc-visibility).

maya (support): Closing loop here: remediation steps we took: 
- Escalated to eng and reproduced bug (LIFO allocation)
- Deployed patch to staging, running QA
- Created CM-1145 and advisory TKT-3429
- Scheduled manual credit transfer + invoice adjustment pending finance approval

sanjay (billing): Finance approved the credit memo. CM-1145 applied. invoice_20240501_8421 balance adjusted to $0.00. You should see the update in Billing > Invoices.

ryan (customer): I see the credit applied and balance is zero. Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick fix and the follow-up. :tada:

lucas (engineer): Prod deploy completed 2024-05-03 18:22Z. All tested allocators now use FIFO by created_at for credit buckets. Added unit tests to prevent regressions.

maya (support): Marking ticket resolved. If anything else pops up on your end, reopen TKT-3429 or ping me directly. :thumbsup:
